ld9.summary: (a) publish modal LMS name, (b) Connect-page logo colour, (c) logo title; no assertion reads any of them.

visibleChanges.what: Publish result modal and course-shell checkbox name the connection's LMS
visibleChanges.before: Modal title 'Published to Moodle', status 'This course is available in the Moodle content picker.', and checkbox 'Also create an empty Moodle course' for every LMS
visibleChanges.after: Modal title 'Published to {LMS}', status 'This course is available in the {LMS} content picker.', and checkbox 'Also create an empty {LMS} course' (using lmsNames[result.lms] / lmsNames[connection.lms])
visibleChanges.whyNoTestMoved: For Moodle in U1/U2 and T6 (tests/e2e/1-scenario-a.spec.ts, 2-scenario-b.spec.ts, tests/acceptance/T6/3-courses.spec.ts, 5-xss-a11y.spec.ts), lmsNames.moodle is 'Moodle' (unchanged). In M2 (tests/e2e/M2/04-detail.m2.ts:67-92, 05-publish-results.m2.ts:10-32, 07-sim-scenario.m2.ts:17-29), Canvas and Blackboard have capabilities.courseShell=false, so the checkbox is absent and clicking Publish closes the dialog without rendering the course-shell result view. Golden G1..G4 captures API DTOs, simulator records, and tool pages (/tool/picker/*, /play/*), not portal UI components.

visibleChanges.what: Connect-page logo uses the channel manifest card colour
visibleChanges.before: color={lms === 'moodle' ? 'orange' : 'red'} (Blackboard was red on the Connect page and blue on the Integrations card)
visibleChanges.after: color={manifest.card.color} (Blackboard is blue on both the Integrations card and the Connect page; Moodle stays orange and Canvas stays red)
visibleChanges.whyNoTestMoved: No U1/U2, T6, or M2 test reads a logo CSS class or computed colour on the Connect page; T6 AC-T6-02 (tests/acceptance/T6/1-integrations.spec.ts:64-88) checks only body background, active pill background, font, and card border-radius on /integrations, and no test compares screenshots.

visibleChanges.what: IntegrationLogo span includes a title attribute with the channel card title
visibleChanges.before: <span aria-hidden='true' className=...> had no title attribute
visibleChanges.after: <span aria-hidden='true' title={name} className=...> sets title to the channel name
visibleChanges.whyNoTestMoved: The span is aria-hidden='true', so title does not affect accessible names in getByRole or getByText, and the only getByTitle / [title] selectors in the frozen suites target Moodle's own tool cards (tests/e2e/lib/moodle.ts:192,303), not the portal logo.

ld9.scanResult: 0 golden changes and 0 frozen-test changes: (a) publish modal LMS name, (b) Connect-page logo colour, (c) logo title; no golden capture (G1..G4) or frozen U1/U2/T6/M2 assertion reads any of them (see visibleChanges[a..c]).
